title: Tower Maze Defense
description: Defend a randomly generated maze path with 5 upgradable tower types against increasingly difficult waves of enemies.
prompt: make a simple tower defense game with only 1 simple map on a 20x20 grid. create 5 different type of towers, each with upgrades. enemies will come in waves that progressively get harder and give more money. the game will have a pause button. maps will randomly generate but make sure they are playable. enemies will come out from 1 end and go out the other end, the game will resemble a simple maze.
